summary: The rerepair closes both previously reported counterexamples and the final clientgap receipt is coherent, but #2533 remains incomplete. routeTrpc now rejects the planted deleted top-level field and wrong responder input, while still accepting wrong canonical field value types, arbitrary array constituents, and wholly nonoverlapping malformed objects without the required named escape.

findings.expected: Issue #2533 requires supported procedure keys, responder input, and success output to derive from AppRouter, with malformed or forward-version wire data admitted only through malformedOrForwardTrpcWire.
findings.actual: ExactObject compares only key overlap/excess and never checks property value assignability. ExactWire accepts every array whenever the canonical output is also an array, without checking element types or keys. Its explicit no-overlap branch returns the actual object unchanged, so malformed wholly nonoverlapping objects bypass the named escape.
counterexamples: routeTrpc(page, { health: { onlyPlaceholder: true } }) typechecks without malformedOrForwardTrpcWire
findings.observed: All three planted @ts-expect-error directives were unused.
findings.testDiscrimination: The committed controls cover a deleted top-level field only when a canonical sibling key remains, plus a wrong input and missing procedure key. They do not check canonical value types, nested/array constituents, or the advertised named-escape exclusivity.
findings.compatibilitySeamJudgment: The wholly nonoverlapping placeholder seam is explicit and bounded in implementation, but it violates #2533's required outcome. The issue says malformed/forward wire must use the named escape and that ordinary success output derives from AppRouter. Source compatibility cannot silently grant ordinary fixtures a second unnamed malformed-wire path.

clientgapReview.status: CONFIRMED within the requested focused review
clientgapReview.procedureSpecificity: The former global intersection-return sweep is gone. Tracing begins at each selected router callback, follows forward call symbol/signature declarations, and admits contextual implementations only when the checker resolves their call signature to the exact reached property declaration.
clientgapReview.implementationIndex: Derived fresh from current packages/server/src variable and property function initializers. It has no maintained symbol, path, procedure, contract, or allowlist inventory. Candidate names are only a lookup acceleration; exact compiler declaration identity decides admission.
clientgapReview.sessionViewControl: The production-shaped control follows admin.listSessions through AdminService.listSessions, AdminContext.sessions.listForUser, and the contextual compose implementation returning SessionView & { userId }. The real source has the same client/router/service/compose chain.
clientgapReview.globalSuppressionRisk: The previous global structural assignability suppression is removed. The implementation index may enumerate candidates globally, but a candidate is not traversed merely because its return is assignable; it must implement the exact declaration reached from the selected procedure.
clientgapReview.remainingBoundary: All contextual implementations of one exact port declaration are potential provenance. This is a declaration-level DI boundary rather than an instance-level composition graph, but it is materially narrower than global structural suppression and matches the current interface-driven composition shape.

performanceAndOomReview.repair: Reverse findReferences traversal was removed; compiler type provenance is shared across procedures and contextual implementation resolutions are cached per declaration.
performanceAndOomReview.cardinalityControl: The 300-procedure focused control passed with one SharedView key and zero unresolved procedures.
performanceAndOomReview.risk: The full typed corpus remains memory-heavy at about 8.8 GB RSS, but the authoritative run completed well below the 16 GB pnpm heap ceiling in about 64 seconds. The focused high-cardinality control plus completed real-tree run provide adequate evidence that the prior 16 GB OOM mechanism was removed.
